name: Word Solver
author: byo-pop
description: HINT (beside SUBMIT) or Tab selects a word the board spells: first one that puts out the lowest fire tile, then the bonus word, the best-scoring words and the longest. Press again for the next. A setting saves the bonus tiles for one big word. Games with it keep their own high scores.

settings.label: Fire tiles first
settings.help: While fire tiles are on the board, the first hint is the word that takes the lowest one.

settings.label: Best words in the cycle
settings.help: How many of the best-scoring words HINT goes through before the longest word and the start again.

settings.label: Show what a hint is
settings.help: A tag above the hint's first tile: best, fire, bonus or longest, its place in the cycle, and a warning for an unsafe word.

settings.label: Save bonus tiles
settings.help: Hints avoid the green, gold, sapphire and diamond tiles where they can, so they stack up on the board. Each one adds to the multiplier of a whole word, so several in one long word score far more. A CASH IN hint, after the best words, is the best word that uses them.
